description: Committee recommends monitoring city agreements with SREDA and Discover Saskatoon.
It also recommends bolstering collaboration between the two agencies.

6 for, 0 against

Councillor Dubois initiated the motion for this review process.

SREDA and Discover Saskatoon committed to strengthening strategic collaboration.

speakers.name: Erin Lawson
said: Supports administration's findings and recommended path forward.
SREDA and Discover Saskatoon have distinct, complementary mandates.
Current governance structure provides transparency and aligns with city priorities.

speakers.name: Stephanie Pocha

said: Administration found Discover Saskatoon and SREDA do distinct, complementary work.
Organizations' work runs in sequence, making each other more effective.
Supports all three recommendations, especially strategic collaboration.

description: Committee recommends selling 902-912 3rd Avenue North for $1.357 million.
Vox Developments will build 58-64 affordable housing units there.
This replaces a failed 2401 Broadway Avenue affordable housing project.

chips.text: Recommended to Council
6 for, 0 against
Sale price for 902-912 3rd Avenue North is $1,357,000.
Councillor Donauer questioned the direct sale policy exception and best value for land.
Affordable housing targets senior earners and students.
Administration justified direct sale as continuation of competitive process.
Councillor Pearce raised concerns about the direct sale setting a precedent.
Administration could not confirm if other developers are interested in the site.
Public feedback opposed rezoning for the original 2401 Broadway Avenue project.
All 58-64 affordable housing units will be locked in for 20 years.
